featured.title: US Measles Cases Jump by 426 in One Week to 5,838, the Largest Rise in Decades
featured.excerpt: The CDC's latest tally is the first since the Pan American Health Organization declared measles endemic in the United States again, ending an elimination status held since 2000.
featured.image_caption: A baby with measles in the Philippines, in a 2014 CDC Global photograph. Confirmed US measles cases rose by 426 in one week to 5,838 as of November 19, according to the CDC.
featured.nri_angle: With 5,838 confirmed cases across 47 jurisdictions and kindergarten MMR coverage down to 92.4%, US-based Indian families should verify every household member's MMR record, especially before holiday travel.
featured.author: Diaspora Desk

editorial.title: Aakasamlo Oka Tara: Dulquer Salmaan Shines in a Heartfelt Journey of Dreams
editorial.excerpt: A tender exploration of aspirations and love that resonates deeply.
editorial.image_caption: Still from the official trailer of 'Aakasamlo Oka Tara'.
editorial.nri_angle: The film's themes of ambition and love resonate deeply with the Indian diaspora, making it a relatable watch for those navigating their own dreams.
editorial.author: Diaspora Desk

data_cards.rating_consensus: A heartfelt journey that inspires, though it occasionally stumbles in pacing and predictability. 3.5 stars.

just_in.title: Traditional Indian Diet and Daily Walks Put 60.9% of Early Diabetes Patients Into Remission
just_in.excerpt: A six-month programme of familiar Indian food in measured portions and 40 minutes of daily walking achieved remission in 53 of 87 adults with recent-onset type 2 diabetes — in a single-arm study its own authors say now needs a controlled trial.
just_in.image_caption: Members of the research team from Chellaram Diabetes Institute, Pune, and Dr Kale's Diabetes and Psychiatry Clinic, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, who ran the six-month dietary intervention study. The study reported remission in 60.9% of participants with early type 2 diabetes.

sources.label: PubMed — LHMC diet and structured exercise for diabetes remission in early type 2 diabetes (study abstract)

just_in.nri_angle: South Asians develop type 2 diabetes earlier and at lower body weights; a remission programme built on the food Indian families already eat — tested in Pune and Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar — is directly relevant to diaspora readers managing early diabetes.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: India Runs More Military Exercises With US Than Any Other Country
just_in.excerpt: A US fact sheet on the Major Defense Partnership catalogues a 2026 calendar spanning Yudh Abhyas, Tarang Shakti, Tiger Triumph and Malabar, alongside the Javelin deal and a first Quad joint exercise planned for 2027.
just_in.image_caption: US Ambassador to India Sergio Gor (centre) poses with Indian Navy officers, including Rear Admiral Srinivas Maddula, and US personnel aboard the aircraft carrier USS George Washington on November 20, 2026. Gor used the visit to highlight expanding India-US military cooperation, joint exercises and information sharing.
just_in.nri_angle: The exercise record underpins the US-India strategic relationship that shapes everything from Indo-Pacific security to defence jobs in both countries.

just_in.title: Modi's December Canada Visit Is Set to Move Ties in a New Direction
just_in.excerpt: Jaishankar and Anand call the December 11-12 visit a "building block" as analyst Vina Nadjibulla argues the India-Canada reset must go beyond trade and rebuild trust on the security track too.
just_in.image_caption: Prime Minister Narendra Modi. Modi will visit Toronto and Ottawa on December 11 and 12 in a trip both governments describe as a building block in rebuilt India-Canada ties.
just_in.nri_angle: For Canada's Indian diaspora, the December visit's CEPA and security-dialogue outcomes will shape trade, travel and community confidence after the 2023 rupture.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Congress Seeks Over 100 UP Seats as Seat-Sharing Talks With SP Open in Delhi
just_in.excerpt: The two INDIA bloc allies began formal negotiations on Monday for the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections, with the SP insisting that winnability, not seat counts, should drive the allocation.
just_in.image_caption: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi, right, speaks at an event in New Delhi in an August 29 file photograph. Gandhi and SP president Akhilesh Yadav held preliminary seat-sharing discussions on November 16, ahead of the formal Congress-SP talks that opened on November 23.
just_in.nri_angle: The UP seat-sharing outcome will shape the opposition alliance diaspora voters from Uttar Pradesh follow ahead of the 2027 Assembly elections.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: OpenAI's Chief Scientist Proposes Common AI Limits Measured by Perplexity
just_in.excerpt: Jakub Pachocki wants rival labs to agree a capability stop line — and not cross it until safety monitoring catches up. Altman called the essay the most important thing OpenAI has published in a while.
just_in.image_caption: OpenAI signage photographed at a company event.
just_in.nri_angle: A shared capability stop line would shape the models Indian-origin researchers and startups build on; for now it is a proposal with no threshold, date or signatories.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Microsoft's Brad Smith Defends Overseas Data Centres After Trump's Penalty Threat
just_in.excerpt: On Face the Nation, Smith split AI training sites from the cloud facilities that must sit near customers — while the Treasury secretary said he had not discussed Trump's proposal with him.
just_in.image_caption: Microsoft President Brad Smith in a portrait photograph. Smith told CBS Face the Nation that cloud data centres serving overseas customers must be located near those customers, after President Trump threatened penalties on companies building data centres abroad.
just_in.nri_angle: Microsoft's $17.5 billion India build-out in Chennai, Hyderabad and Pune sits inside the policy debate, but neither side named India as a target and no change was announced.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: A. R. Rahman Spent Three Years on 'Ramayana' Music, Turned Down 10–12 Films
just_in.excerpt: At IFFI in Panaji, the composer said he set aside almost everything else for Nitesh Tiwari's two-part epic, co-composing with Hans Zimmer — some pieces went through 12–13 versions.
just_in.image_caption: A. R. Rahman with the Banaras team at a press conference during the International Film Festival of India in Goa.
just_in.nri_angle: Rahman and Hans Zimmer's three-year score is the musical backbone of the Diwali epic diaspora audiences are watching in theatres now.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Modi and Nepal's Balen Shah to Flag Off Ayodhya–Janakpur Express on November 23

just_in.nri_angle: A direct Ayodhya–Janakpur train gives diaspora pilgrims a single-train Ramayana-circuit journey between India and Nepal for the first time.

just_in.title: Navdeep Bains Wins Ontario Liberal Leadership on Final Ballot, 50.3 to 49.7
just_in.excerpt: The former federal industry minister from Mississauga beat MPP Lee Fairclough by less than a point after a nine-month race, and now has to rebuild a party that holds 14 seats.
just_in.image_caption: Navdeep Bains speaks in Toronto during coverage of the Ontario Liberal Party leadership result. Bains won the leadership on the third ballot on November 21, 2026, with 50.3 per cent of the weighted points.
just_in.nri_angle: A Sikh former federal minister from Mississauga — home to one of Canada's largest South Asian communities — now leads a major provincial party.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Edmonton's Sneha Joy Wins $5 Million Lotto 6/49 Jackpot
just_in.excerpt: Joy matched all six numbers in the October 21 Classic draw with a ticket bought on the Lotto Spot app, and plans to clear her mortgage, travel the world and share with family.
just_in.image_caption: Sneha Joy holds a $5,000,000 Lotto Spot cheque dated October 21, 2026, for the Lotto 6/49 draw. The Edmonton winner matched all six numbers in the Classic draw, the Western Canada Lottery Corporation announced.

just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Princeton PhD Student Eva Yi Xie Detained by ICE After Neuroscience Conference
just_in.excerpt: Her lawyers say a pending asylum claim lets her stay; ICE says she never had authorisation to study in the US. A federal judge has barred her removal from Virginia while her habeas petition is heard.
just_in.image_caption: A US Immigration and Customs Enforcement badge, in an Associated Press photograph. Princeton doctoral student Eva Yi Xie was detained by ICE at Reagan National Airport on November 19, 2026.
just_in.nri_angle: The detention happened on a domestic flight by a researcher with a pending asylum claim — a concrete reminder for international students and scholars in the US to verify their status with a lawyer before travelling, even inside the country.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Manipur Spurious Liquor Death Toll Rises to 17, About 230 People in Hospital
news.excerpt: Sixteen of the dead are from Chandel district and one from Kakching. Officials say 1,130 people have been screened, six arrests made and 4,600 litres of illicit liquor seized.
news.nri_angle: For Manipuri families abroad, the confirmed figures — 17 dead, about 230 admitted, screening locations and hospital names — are the verified update to share instead of circulating rumours.

news.title: Modi Dedicates Nitish Setu, New Six-Lane Ganga Bridge in Bihar
news.excerpt: The 19.7 km Kachhi Dargah–Bidupur crossing links Patna and Vaishali districts and anchors a ₹34,470 crore package of Bihar projects inaugurated on Saturday.
news.nri_angle: A new Ganga crossing cutting Patna–Vaishali travel to about 20-25 minutes matters to diaspora families traveling to north Bihar.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Air India Crash Probe in Final Stage, Government Tells Supreme Court
news.excerpt: Solicitor General Tushar Mehta sought two to three weeks to finish the AI171 investigation as the court weighs petitions for an independent probe.
news.image_caption: The tail section of Air India flight AI171 in the wreckage of the Ahmedabad building the aircraft struck after take-off in June 2025.
news.nri_angle: AI171 was an Ahmedabad-London flight carrying many diaspora families; its final report is the document relatives in India, the UK and North America have waited 17 months for.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Modi at IIT Kharagpur's 75th Year: 'Break the Limits, Unlock the Possibilities'
news.excerpt: At the platinum jubilee of India's first IIT, the Prime Minister interacted with 75 students, unveiled a commemorative coin, and pointed to poverty numbers, chip exports and Skyroot's rocket as proof that 'too late' is a mindset.
news.image_caption: Prime Minister Narendra Modi addresses the platinum jubilee celebrations of IIT Kharagpur.
news.nri_angle: IIT Kharagpur's alumni are spread across the diaspora's tech and space industries — Modi's shout-out to Skyroot co-founder Pawan Kumar Chandana, an alumnus, lands directly with them.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: US Court Dispatches Summonses to Doval, Goel in Pannun Case via Delhi Courts
news.excerpt: The Southern District of New York sent the summonses by FedEx to the Patiala House, Tis Hazari and Dwarka courts under the Hague Convention, after service through India's central authority was attempted and rejected — a route New Delhi says is not lawful.
news.image_caption: National Security Adviser Ajit Doval, photographed at an event.
news.nri_angle: The service fight decides whether a US civil suit naming India's NSA and a former R&AW chief can proceed at all — a case diaspora readers have followed since the 2023 murder-for-hire allegations.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.nri_angle: For diaspora families with relatives in India, the free single-dose programme means a 14-year-old daughter or niece can be vaccinated at a government facility with a slot booked on U-WIN.

nri-world.nri_angle: For OCI cardholders, the ruling sets a procedural floor: before a cancellation can stand, the government must spell out the specific allegations — or at least a redacted gist — so the holder can actually answer them.

nri-world.title: Tanker Hit Near Khasab as Hormuz Traffic Stays About 65% Below Pre-War Levels
nri-world.excerpt: UKMTO reported a fresh projectile strike on an outbound tanker on Saturday, six tanker attacks in a week, and oil flows down to about 10 million barrels a day — with Indian crew among the week's casualties.
nri-world.image_caption: Khasab, on Oman's Musandam Peninsula at the entrance to the Strait of Hormuz.
nri-world.nri_angle: Indian seafarers crew many Gulf tankers and Gulf-based Indian families live beside ports running at a third of pre-war traffic — the strait's closure is a direct diaspora story, not a distant one.

immigration.title: 12,700 Indian Tech Professionals Returned From the US in Nine Months, Xpheno Data Shows
immigration.excerpt: Returns on the India–US corridor rose from 7,200 in 2023 to 15,100 in 2025, and 2026 is on pace to approach that record — but with about 14,500 moving the other way, the flow remains two-way, and the figures are recruitment-data estimates, not a government count.
immigration.nri_angle: Indian tech workers in the US weighing a return can see the measured scale of the flow, what the Xpheno estimates do and do not count, and exactly who the $100,000 H-1B payment does and does not apply to.

immigration.nri_angle: Renewal delays that outrun USCIS's own 120-day goal are the practical risk for work-authorized immigrants, including Indian-origin DACA holders and their employers.

immigration.image_caption: A US Immigration and Customs Enforcement badge, in an Associated Press photograph. Princeton doctoral student Eva Yi Xie was detained by ICE at Reagan National Airport on November 19, 2026.
immigration.nri_angle: The detention happened on a domestic flight by a researcher with a pending asylum claim — a concrete reminder for international students and scholars in the US to verify their status with a lawyer before travelling, even inside the country.

immigration.title: NRI Seafarers Can Now Use a Job Contract or Seaman's Book to Open an NPS Account
immigration.excerpt: PFRDA's November 13 circular lets NRI seafarers use a valid employment contract or a Continuous Discharge Certificate with a disembarkation record under six months old as proof of address for NPS Tier I accounts.
immigration.nri_angle: Removes the overseas-address-proof barrier that kept NRI seafarers — a large Indian maritime workforce — out of NPS pension accounts.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: ICE Holds Texas Store Worker After Jail Term Over Customer's Private Photos
immigration.excerpt: Raghul Anandakrishnan, 29, was convicted of attempted invasive visual recording after a customer said he tried to AirDrop her intimate photos to himself. ICE took him from the Travis County jail and will hold him pending immigration court proceedings.
immigration.nri_angle: Shows how a local criminal conviction can move a non-citizen directly into ICE detention, and why sharing a phone passcode at a retail counter carries real risk.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: ICE Arrests Two on Sea-Tac Jetway, Delaying Los Angeles-Bound Flight
immigration.excerpt: Washington's governor called the jetway arrests 'deeply un-American' and urged airlines to push ICE out of airports; Alaska Airlines said it had no advance notice.
immigration.image_caption: A passenger is handcuffed by officers during an arrest at Seattle-Tacoma International Airport on Saturday. ICE said the operation targeted a man who had overstayed his visa, and a second passenger was also arrested.
immigration.nri_angle: Airport arrests of visa overstayers are directly relevant to diaspora travelers with pending applications or past overstays flying US domestic routes.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: Deported in 1999, Brooklyn Man Can Still Seek Sale of Home Bought in 1985, Court Rules
immigration.excerpt: New York's Appellate Division held that because Clyde Nelson's 2007 divorce never disposed of the Brooklyn house, his ownership share survived — and his former wife cannot use the divorce to block his partition claim.
immigration.image_caption: The Brooklyn skyline in New York. A state appeals court ruled on November 18 that a co-owner removed from the US in 1999 can still seek the sale of a Brooklyn home bought in 1985.
immigration.nri_angle: The ruling shows removal from the US does not erase deed rights, and that a divorce silent on property leaves a deported spouse's share intact.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: Senate Bill Asks Labor Department for a Plan on PERM Premium Processing
immigration.excerpt: Appropriators want a report within 60 days of enactment on a fee-based fast track for green card labor certifications that now average about 300 days — but no premium option exists yet.
immigration.nri_angle: PERM is the first green card stage for most H-1B professionals, a heavily Indian cohort; a paid fast track would cut a roughly 300-day wait at the Labor Department stage.

sports.title: Who Is Anupama Ramachandran? The Chennai Cueist Who Became the First Indian Woman to Win a World Snooker Title — and Just Defended It at Home
sports.excerpt: Born in Chennai in 2002, Anupama Ramachandran chose snooker over chess at a Mylapore Club summer camp at 13, won a world under-16 title at 15, and in November 2025 became the first Indian woman to win the IBSF World Snooker Championship — then defended it in Indore on November 21, 2026, to become the first Indian to win back-to-back world snooker crowns, all while completing two postgraduate degrees.

sports.nri_angle: The Chennai cueist who became the first Indian woman to win a world snooker title — and the first Indian to defend one — gives diaspora fans a new name at the top of a sport India had never conquered, and a visible path for girls who want to follow her to the table.

technology.title: Anthropic's Record $81.3 Billion IPO Opens 34% Higher, Then Fades to a 17% Gain

technology.title: India's AI Funding Nearly Doubles to $1.6 Billion, With Mumbai Ahead of Bengaluru

technology.title: OpenAI's Chief Scientist Proposes Common AI Limits Measured by Perplexity

technology.image_caption: OpenAI signage photographed at a company event.
technology.nri_angle: A shared capability stop line would shape the models Indian-origin researchers and startups build on; for now it is a proposal with no threshold, date or signatories.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Microsoft's Brad Smith Defends Overseas Data Centres After Trump's Penalty Threat

technology.image_caption: Microsoft President Brad Smith in a portrait photograph. Smith told CBS Face the Nation that cloud data centres serving overseas customers must be located near those customers, after President Trump threatened penalties on companies building data centres abroad.

technology.title: A Cancer Vaccine Made for One Patient? Hyderabad's RNA Foundry Is Building It

carousel.title: Adani Energy Wins 25-Year Bengal Deal for 1,750 MW of Round-the-Clock Renewable Power
carousel.excerpt: The Letter of Award from WBSEDCL covers 1,750 MW from July 2028, with a 750 MW option that would take the total to 2,500 MW if exercised. No tariff or contract value was disclosed.
carousel.image_caption: Archival photograph: Gautam Adani (right) at an event in West Bengal in September 2026. Adani Energy Solutions said its subsidiary has won a 25-year award to supply 1,750 MW of round-the-clock renewable power to the state discom.
carousel.nri_angle: For diaspora investors tracking Adani group stocks, the investable facts are the awarded 1,750 MW and 2028 start — the 2,500 MW headline includes an unexercised option, and no tariff was disclosed.
